text: Codebase sync — keeps internal branches aligned with no user-facing changes.
A new floating option for the TabBar component adapts the navigation to fit either rounded card or full-bleed layouts. 📱
Native folder selection and a three-step wizard in 'Create App' — saves customized components directly to your local workspace. 📁
DraggableList component padding — keeps lifted row shadows and scaled cards from clipping while dragging. 📐
Subtle background tint on non-solid Badges — makes label text easier to read in both light and dark themes. 🏷️
Active Input and Select fields use accent colors to make focused or open form elements easier to spot.
Flat cards in the Create App wizard use transparent backgrounds — removes heavy container fills to keep the layout clean and easy to scan.
Explicit aria-label on the sidebar search input — helps screen readers and automated tools identify the search box.
Flat Card variants strip borders and backgrounds automatically — eliminates custom style overrides for borderless layouts.
